rows.description: Dungeon room shell on the 4 m grid: one-sided relief walls (mossy plinth, cut-stone body, stepped cornice), pilasters on cell boundaries, flagstone floor with a dressed border, door cuts on cell-edge midpoints for dgn.doorway frames, torch

rows.name: Rubble

rows.name: Stairs

rows.description: Modular wall segment for one (or two) cell edges: origin on the cell boundary, inner face 0.5 m in front. Kinds: solid, door (cut for dgn.doorway), slit (window slit with splayed reveal and a cold glow plate), alcove (arched niche), relief

rows.description: Breakable dungeon containers: round clay pot with a rolled lip, tall two-handled urn, or a stack of iron-cornered timber crates.

rows.description: Iron-banded timber treasure chest with a barrel lid, corner caps and a lock plate; large = the big ornate key chest. open: lid swung back.

rows.description: Rune tablet: rounded-top standing stone on a stepped base with a recessed panel of softly glowing original glyphs (emissive, period-correct, no text).

rows.description: Bed: box/nook/pod/cot frame, mattress, pillows, draped blanket, headboard.

rows.description: Seat: stool, chair, armchair or bench; four legs, pedestal or sled base; optional cushion.
rows.name: Chair

rows.description: Console: smooth mushroom pod (glowing screen ring + top panels, joystick ledge), blobby kidney desk with a rippled rolled rim carrying 1-3 rounded CRT monitors on tube legs, terminal, lectern. Screens use role 'screen' (emissive).

rows.description: Container: crate, barrel, chest (hinged kit_lid), basket, locker, capsule.
rows.name: Chest

rows.description: Heat source: stone fireplace, stove with pipe, brazier, molded heater (emissive 'fire').
rows.name: Hearth

rows.description: Lamp: floor/table/hanging/lantern/sphere; shade cone/sphere/drum/dome (emissive role 'light'). height = overall height (floor/table/sphere/lantern) or cord drop (hanging); base applies to floor/table/sphere, shade to floor/table/hanging.

rows.description: Molded seating: glossy bowl pod with a front-lowered rim and quilted back lobes, chaise tub of quilted lobes with lens portholes and trumpet pedestal feet (+ visor), egg chair with a scooped opening, round conversation pit with throws, pill

rows.description: Rug: thin slab, rect/round/oval, optional fringe.
rows.name: Rug

rows.description: Bookshelf, cabinet (doors) or open rack; seeded book groups.
rows.name: Bookshelf

rows.description: Table: rect/round/oval/flower/kidney top; four legs, pedestal, trestle, tulip or solid plinth base; optional ornament.
rows.name: Table

rows.description: Underwater lake floor tile: soft sandy bed with pebble patches at the given depth below the water surface (origin = water surface centre), rounded stones and swaying weed tufts; seen from underwater views (fog tint).
rows.name: Bed

rows.description: Boat-less crossing over water, north-south: stepping stones (flat rounded rock tops in a meandering line) or a low plank walkway on piles with rope rails. Origin at the crossing centre on the land datum.
rows.name: Bridge

rows.description: Timber dock: plank deck on round piles running out over the water from the shore, edge stringers, mooring posts with rope and an optional ladder.
rows.name: Dock

rows.description: Floating lily pads (thin notched discs) with closed water-lily blooms; origin on the water surface.
rows.name: Lilies

rows.description: Reed clump: thin tapering blades (closed three-sided spines) arching outward from a tuft, with cattail heads; solid geometry so it reads in every pack (no alpha).
rows.name: Reeds

rows.description: Shoreline cell (4 x 4 m): land at the datum on the north side sloping under the water to the south (straight), around a convex corner (corner_out: water south and east) or a concave cove (corner_in); grass on top, a pebble beach band throug
rows.name: Shore

rows.description: Lake water surface tile: tessellated one-sided plane at the water level (origin = water surface centre) with the pack's painted water role; N64 vertex wobble + slow UV scroll declared as material extras (bounded by the lake gate). Tiles edg
rows.name: Water

rows.description: Waterfall: a bowed falling-water sheet (pack water role, fast downward scroll stretched into streaks) pouring from a rounded rock lip, white foam puffs and a churned pool rim at the foot. Front faces -Y; origin at the pool centre on the wat
rows.name: Waterfall

rows.description: Raised paved causeway for one cell (3 m wide deck running north-south): a battered stone body, worn path paving on top and kerb stones along both edges; steps = a short flight down to the ground at the south end; end = a rounded terminus; b
rows.name: Causeway

rows.description: Mesa cliff on cell edges: a strata-banded face (cliff role) with jittered ledges, eroded buttresses and a sand cap on top; straight = a run along one edge, corner = an outer corner, end = a tapering spur, pillar = a free mesa butte. Closed
rows.name: Cliff

rows.description: Ground tile on the RUIN GRID (cells x 4 m square, open sheet facing up): sand = soft dune ripples (sand role); jungle = earth and moss patches with hummocks (dirt role); paved = worn flagstones (path role); court = flat paving (path role).

rows.description: Sky backdrop set: inward-facing dome (kit_shell_sky, role 'sky': the pack's painted deep zenith, pale horizon haze = fog colour, and the sun) plus an optional ring of distant silhouettes in the vista_far role (flat-topped mesas, rolling dun
rows.name: Sky

rows.description: Distant skyline card for the far band (vista_far role, so it takes the pack's horizon haze and most of the distance fog): one flat silhouette facing south. city = an original temple-city outline (stepped pyramids, a pylon pair, obelisk spik
rows.name: Skyline

rows.description: Slope between terrace levels inside one cell run (4 m long, width_cells x 4 m wide): a soft S-curved sand or earth ramp climbing north with cliff-role flanks. Sockets at the foot (ground datum) and the crest (at the rise).
rows.name: Slope

rows.description: Raised terrace / plateau block for tiered terrain: a flat top (sand or earth-and-moss) on battered, eroded cliff-role sides, cells x 4 m at the top so a land.slope crest or a stair flight meets its edge on the grid. Closed solid; the foot s
rows.name: Terrace

rows.description: Dry wash / stream-bed ground tile: a cells x 4 m ground sheet with a meandering sunken channel running north-south (the channel re-centres on the tile's north and south edges so washes chain tile to tile) and a scatter of rounded pebbles in
rows.name: Wash

rows.description: Shrub: a round bush, a flowering bush, a berry bush, or a low tangled bramble.
rows.name: Bush

rows.description: Leafless tree: a gnarled trunk splitting into crooked bare branches (winter / spooky), optionally snow-laden.
rows.name: Dead Tree

rows.description: Farm field on the grid (cells x cells, origin at the centre, ground at y = 0): standing wheat as a golden bevelled mass with a ragged top, rows of cabbages, ploughed furrows, or a vineyard of staked rows.
rows.name: Field

rows.description: Small ground dressing: a patch of meadow flowers, grass tufts, waterside reeds, or a ring of mushrooms.
rows.name: Flowers

rows.description: Hedgerow on a cell edge (4 m along X): a clipped-but-lumpy hedge, a corner turning south, or a hedge with a field gap. wall_end sockets (hedge) at +-2 m so hedges, fences and walls interlock.
rows.name: Hedgerow

rows.description: Oak: a stout tapered trunk with two limbs under a broad crown of four lumpy foliage masses (broad), a slim young oak, or an old pollarded oak with a thicker trunk and a lower, wider crown.
rows.name: Oak

rows.description: Orchard fruit tree: a short crooked trunk under a rounded crown dotted with fruit (apple / pear), in blossom, or bare winter branches.
rows.name: Orchard

rows.description: Pine / fir: a straight trunk under stacked drooping tiers of needles (foliage role), tall or short; the snowy kind caps every tier with snow.
rows.name: Pine

rows.description: Rocks: a mossy boulder, a cluster of three, a tall weathered standing stone, or a low layered outcrop.
rows.name: Rock

rows.description: A sawn tree stump with root flares, a fallen log, or a mossy log with a fungus shelf.
rows.name: Stump

rows.description: Blacksmith's anvil with a horn and heel on an oak stump, optionally with tongs and hammer.
rows.name: Anvil

rows.description: Oak barrel with two iron hoops: upright, lying on its side, a small keg, or an open water butt.
rows.name: Barrel

rows.description: Woven wicker basket (wattle role) with apples, loaves or wool, or empty.
rows.name: Basket

rows.description: Bed: a plank cot with a straw mattress, blanket and pillow, or a four-poster with a cloth tester.
rows.name: Bed

rows.description: Seating: a plank bench, a three-legged stool, or a high-backed settle.
rows.name: Bench

rows.description: Wooden pail with two iron bands and a rope handle, optionally full of water.
rows.name: Bucket

rows.description: Two-wheeled farm cart: plank bed with side boards, spoked-look wheels, shafts resting on the ground, loaded with hay, barrels or sacks, or empty.
rows.name: Cart

rows.description: Iron cauldron hung from a tripod over a ring of stones, with a glowing fire (baked warm pool).
rows.name: Cauldron

rows.description: Treasure / travel chest: oak body with a rounded lid, iron straps and a lock plate (iron) or plain boards; the lid shut or thrown open (a state pair for module flags).
rows.name: Chest

rows.description: Plank crate with corner battens and a diagonal brace (braced), an open-slatted produce crate, or a small box.
rows.name: Crate

rows.description: Treadle grindstone: a sandstone wheel on an oak frame with a crank and a water trough.
rows.name: Grindstone

rows.description: Straw: a tied bale, a stack of three bales, or a domed hay rick on a timber base.
rows.name: Hay

rows.description: Lamp post: an oak post (on a stone footing) with an iron bracket and a glowing lantern cage; its warm pool is baked into its own vertices.
rows.name: Lantern

rows.description: Hung lanterns: a wall lantern on an iron bracket (wall-face anchor, front +Z, for lantern sockets) or a lantern hanging on a chain (origin at the ceiling hook). The cage glows; its warm pool is baked into its own vertices.
rows.name: Lantern Hung

rows.description: Tied burlap sack (pale cloth), a pile of three, or an open sack of grain.
rows.name: Sack

rows.description: Wall shelf (wall-face anchor, front +Z): two oak boards on brackets carrying jugs and bowls, or books.
rows.name: Shelf

rows.description: Wall shield (wall-face anchor, front +Z): a heater or round shield carrying an original heraldic charge (band atlas), with a dark rim.
rows.name: Shield

rows.description: Signposts with BLANK faces (paper role, never text: games paint their own): a fingerpost with pointed arms, a post with a hanging board on a bracket, or a little roofed notice board.
rows.name: Signpost

rows.description: Tavern / hall table: a trestle table, a round table on a post and feet, or a long feast table.
rows.name: Table

rows.description: Table dressing: a trencher with bread and a jug (meal), tankards round a pitcher (drinks), or a pair of lit candlesticks (baked warm pool).
rows.name: Tableware

rows.description: Hollowed log / plank trough on two blocks, filled with water or hay.
rows.name: Trough

rows.description: Armoury rack: an oak frame holding spears, swords, or round shields with original heraldic charges.
rows.name: Weapon Rack

rows.description: Firewood: a stacked log pile against two stakes, or a chopping block with split logs and an axe.
rows.name: Woodpile

rows.description: Far backdrop (origin at the viewer): an inward-facing band of rolling hills (vista role) in front of a far ridge (vista_far) that carries two original castle silhouettes (square keep with corner turrets, a round tower pair with a curtain),
rows.name: Backdrop

rows.description: Terrace edge on a cell edge (4 m along X; the high side toward +Y): a grassy bank, a rock face with a grass lip, or a rubble retaining wall with a coping. Pairs with vlg.stairs for level changes.
rows.name: Bank

rows.description: Ground tile, one 4 m cell (or a plain cells x cells block) (origin at the centre, top at y = 0): grass meadow, cobbles, dirt, flagstone plaza, snow, or a field edge; optionally crossed by a cobbled path (straight / corner / tee / cross / en
rows.name: Ground

rows.description: Rolling hill: a smooth cosine mound on a coarse grid (grass on gentle slopes, rock on the steep ones), skirt at y = 0 so it sits on any ground tile.
rows.name: Hill

rows.description: Water on the grid: a river reach across one cell (4 m along X) with grassy banks, a castle moat segment with rubble revetments, or a round pond with a reed-and-stone rim (water role scrolls).
rows.name: Water

rows.description: Bush/shrub of overlapping blobs; optional flower heads (role 'flower') and cap (snow/moss).
rows.name: Bush

rows.description: Grass tuft: solid 3-sided blades (closed pyramids) with optional flower heads.
rows.name: Grass Tuft

rows.description: Rock or cluster: star-shaped noise-displaced spheres (never self-intersecting), sunk into the ground; optional cap.
rows.name: Rock

rows.description: Tree: broadleaf blobs, stacked conifer tiers, bare branching (cap = snow-laden), birch, palm, crystal (faceted ice trunk, angular branches, glass shards; additive 3.2).
rows.name: Tree

rows.description: Crater tile (8 m): a bowl with a raised rim (rim faces rock role) inside a flat-edged regolith tile.
rows.name: Crater

rows.description: Dune tile (8 m): wind ridges with a sharp crest and soft lee slope running east-west, fading to flat ground on every edge (sand role, crests path role for a lighter tone).
rows.name: Dune

rows.description: Planet ground tile (8 m): closed regolith slab, gently undulating inside and flat at its level on all four edges, optional low rock bumps (rock role). Interlocks with any tile whose edge is ground at the same level.
rows.name: Ground

rows.description: Mesa: a flat-topped strata plateau with tapering eroded sides and a ledge band (cliff sides, sand top), a landmark for alien regions; stands on the ground anywhere off the tile grid.
rows.name: Mesa

rows.description: Landing pad tile (8 m): flat ground tile carrying a round bevelled hex-plated pad (floor role) with a hazard ring and up to four beacon posts with glowing heads. Interlocks as level-0 ground.
rows.name: Pad

rows.name: Ridge

rows.description: Rise tile (8 m): a smooth ramp from level 0 on the south edge to level 2 (or 6) on the north edge; east/west edges follow the shared ramp profile, steep cells take the cliff role.
rows.name: Rise

rows.description: Trail tile (8 m): a 2.4 m packed trail (path role) worn slightly into flat-edged ground, crossing the tile on the trail edges; neighbours must carry the trail on the shared edge.
rows.name: Trail

rows.description: Books: single closed, open (two page blocks), stack (lying) or row (standing, varied heights).
rows.name: Book

rows.description: Small device: radio, lantern (glowing core), tablet, clock, beacon, camera; emissive parts use roles light/screen.
rows.name: Pocket Device

rows.description: Key: classic (ring bow, teeth), skeleton (ornate bow), keycard, crystal key. Lies flat (origin on the floor).
rows.name: Key

rows.description: Sign: post sign, hanging (bracket + chains as rods), standing A-board, wall plaque (wall_mounted variant), arrow; text = abstract glyph strips.
rows.name: Sign

rows.description: Hand tool lying on the ground (origin at the grip centre projected to the floor): hammer, wrench, shovel, axe, pick, broom, flashlight, fishing rod.
rows.name: Hand Tool

rows.description: Vessel by lathe profile: mug, bowl, bottle, jar, vase, pot, kettle, cup; optional handle, lid and contents.
rows.name: Vessel

rows.description: Altar: stepped base, a dressed block with a carved procession relief on its front and a moulded top. basin = glazed offering bowl; sun = gold sun disc on a stand (the shrine focus); fire = a fire bowl (runtime emitter).
rows.name: Altar

rows.description: Woven banner on a wall bracket (wall-mounted, origin on the wall face): a crossbar with gold finials and a hanging cloth with a woven border and an original rayed-sun emblem (fabric role, two-sided).
rows.name: Banner

rows.description: Brazier: gold-leaf bowl on a bronze tripod, on a carved stone pedestal, or a low stone fire pit; a lit flame (emissive) and a runtime warm emitter (meta.emitter, mirrored in view.json look.emitters). unlit = cold tripod.
rows.name: Brazier

rows.description: Reliquary coffer (the goal object): a carved stone casket on four squat feet with gold corner caps and a lid carrying the sun inlay; open = lid tipped back on its hinge showing the dark inside.
rows.name: Coffer

rows.description: Sun-dial puzzle dais: a round stepped platform, a ring of tapered ray stones and a central gnomon with a gold tip; ruined = two rays toppled and a cracked step. Socket 'puzzle' at the gnomon.
rows.name: Dial

rows.description: Pressure-plate floor tile (1.2 m): a sunk stone frame and a plate carrying the sun inlay (frame role) or a glyph (hull role); raised = 8 cm proud, pressed = flush. Socket 'plate' at the centre (triggers stay in game data).
rows.name: Plate

rows.description: Sarcophagus: a stone chest with incised glyph bands along both sides on a plinth, and a battered lid carved with the sun-wheel relief; open = lid slid aside showing the dark interior; broken = lid cracked in two on the floor.
rows.name: Sarcophagus

rows.description: Statue of an ORIGINAL invented figure: keeper = robed standing figure holding a gold sun disc under a fan crown of three fins, with a back pillar, on a stepped plinth (3.4 m); guardian = seated crested beast (plate crest, curled tail, gold
rows.name: Statue

rows.description: Glyph stone: stele = round-topped standing slab with an incised glyph face (original glyph grammar, hull role) on a base; tablet = a low inclined tablet on a stand (paper role glyphs); fallen = a stele broken in two in the sand; awakened =
rows.name: Tablet

rows.description: Painted clay urn (terracotta with painted bands and a zigzag frieze; glazed bowl): jar, two-handled amphora, wide bowl, or a broken jar with a jagged rim and a shard.
rows.name: Urn

rows.description: Freestanding arch: two chamfered piers with moulded bases; round = voussoir ring with a carved keystone; corbel = stepped corbel vault outline; broken = one pier and a fallen half-ring among blocks.
rows.name: Arch

rows.description: Temple column (original order): stepped square plinth, rounded base ring, faceted shaft with entasis and two carved limestone rings, a flared 'sun cup' capital under a square abacus. broken = snapped shaft with a fallen drum; stump = plinth
rows.name: Column

rows.description: Sunken court: stepped stone terraces rising outward around a court floor at y = 0 (the player's floor), swept as one closed stepped profile with mitred corners; open sides leave a 4 m entrance gap centred on that side (door sockets there).
rows.name: Court

rows.description: Paving slab for one RUIN GRID cell (4 x 4 m, 5 cm proud of the ground, chamfered) on a joint bed that fills the joints with sand/moss: plain; cracked = broken slabs with sand between; inlay = central sun inlay (frame role); block = 2 x 2 ce
rows.name: Floor

rows.name: Gate

rows.description: Obelisk: tapered square shaft on a two-step base, glyph panels (original glyph grammar, hull role) on all four faces and a sphere-mapped gold cap. broken = snapped shaft with the top lying beside it; short = waist-high waystone.
rows.name: Obelisk

rows.description: Corner pier on a cell corner: chamfered square shaft on a moulded base with a stepped capital; hides the joint where two walls meet. broken = ragged snapped top; low = parapet post.
rows.name: Pier

rows.description: Stepped pyramid: battered tiers with a dressed lip, an optional stair flight up the south face with sloped balustrades, and an optional summit shrine (doorway house under a stepped roof) or altar. tiers = 1 is a single walkable tier block.
rows.name: Pyramid

rows.description: Rampart on a cell edge: battered outer face, a 2 m walk on top and a crenellated parapet (tapered merlons); corner = L-shaped quarter; tower = round bastion; broken = a breach with spilled blocks.
rows.name: Rampart

rows.description: Collapsed rubble: tumbled dressed blocks and broken stone (small, large pile), blocks half-buried in a drifted sand mound (drift), or a heap of column drums.
rows.name: Rubble

rows.name: Stairs

rows.name: Wall

rows.description: Service drone (0.9 m): lathed saucer body with a sensor eye, three thruster rings on short arms, resting on three small feet; cargo variant clutches a crate.
rows.name: Drone

rows.description: Escape pod (2.7 m): faceted octagonal cone capsule with a scorched heat-shield skirt, three fin legs, a round side hatch (open variant swings it aside over a dark opening) and a beacon light on top.
rows.name: Escape Pod

rows.description: Cargo hauler (12 m): long chamfered spine with a bubble cab at the nose, clamp frames carrying up to four cargo pods with hazard bands, four rear nacelles and tapered landing legs. Original silhouette.
rows.name: Hauler

rows.description: Planet rover (4.6 m): raised chamfered chassis with a slant-glass cab, cargo deck with a light bar, sensor mast and dish, six (or four) lathed wheels with hub caps.
rows.name: Rover

rows.description: Small shuttle (6.6 m): blunt-nosed octagonal wedge with a dorsal spine, slanted canopy, downswept stub wings ending in round tip pods, twin rear thrusters with glowing bells and landing skids (optional belly cargo pod). Original silhouette.
rows.name: Shuttle

rows.description: Sky backdrop: inward-facing dome or cylinder (kit_shell_sky, role 'sky', v = elevation 0..1). Origin at the viewer; extends below y=0 by below_horizon*radius.

rows.description: Blanket: folded stack, rolled log, or spread flat with soft seeded waves (thin closed slab).
rows.name: Blanket

rows.description: Pillow/cushion: puffy square, round, bolster, floor cushion, heart; optional centre tuft button and piping.
rows.name: Cushion

rows.description: Airlock leaves for the 2.0 x 2.6 doorway cut (insert piece, flag-swapped closed -> open): two white leaves with a hazard-striped zig-zag seal and a round lock hub. Origin on the door anchor like stn.doorway.

rows.description: Station corridor cell (4 m, 3 m clear, 3.2 m high): chamfered octagonal section, mitred one-sided walls with a recessed light band, floor and ceiling sheets, cap ledges for the cutaway; corridor sockets on open cell-edge midpoints.

rows.description: Deck tile for one cell laid over a room floor: raised bevelled hex plates, a framed grate, a plain bevelled deck plate or a circular marked pad. Origin on the cell centre.
rows.name: Floor

rows.name: Hangar

rows.description: Lift platform for one cell: bevelled round platform with a hazard rim, tapered guide columns, a top guide ring with a light band and a call post on the front. Origin on the cell centre.
rows.name: Lift

rows.description: Station room shell: deck floor + mitred one-sided chamfered walls (kick chamfer, panels, light band, upper chamfer to a 4 m ceiling line) with door / viewport cuts on side-cell midpoints and pilaster ribs. Ceiling: stn.ceiling. Origin on th
rows.name: Room

rows.description: Stairs, ramp or dais for raised decks (command platforms, catwalk ends): one solid zig-zag flight with grille treads, tapered side stringers, tube handrails on posts. Origin on the footprint centre.
rows.name: Stairs

rows.description: Viewport window for a room-wall cut: chamfered frame (depth through the wall), sill ledge and a star-field card behind (dark space, nebula, a distant violet planet). Origin on the wall anchor (0.6 m behind the inner face, side-cell midpoint
rows.name: Viewport

rows.description: Cable run: a bundle of tube cables (wavy on the floor or sagging between bracket posts) ending in chamfered junction boxes; cables never interpenetrate (laterally offset).
rows.name: Cables

rows.description: Robot charging pod: curved alcove wall with a canopy and light strips, a round contact pad with a glowing ring, and (optional) a dormant service robot of original design (dome head, visor, stubby arm pods) docked on it. Alcove opens to -Y.
rows.name: Charge Pod

rows.description: Operator console: chamfered plinth, tapered body set back from the toes, slanted desk with painted emissive screens and a light strip, side fins; tall adds a leaning back display. Operator side -Y.
rows.name: Console

rows.description: Cargo crate: chamfered bevelled box with corner bumpers and an optional hazard band; stack piles a small crate on a large one (2 mm gap, no interpenetration).
rows.name: Crate

rows.description: Standing cryo pod: hexagonal plinth with a light band, elliptic lathed capsule, oval glass window on the front, two hoses from the domed cap into the back. open swings the window door aside.
rows.name: Cryo Pod

rows.description: Holo-table stand: hexagonal lathe with a wide foot, tapered neck and flared top, a light rim and an emitter disc; an optional small globe hovers over the emitter (a static prop, no hologram shader).
rows.name: Holo Table

rows.description: Locker bank against a wall (back on y = 0 before centring): chamfered carcass with a sloped top, raised doors with vent slots and grip bars, a label strip per door.
rows.name: Locker

rows.description: Reactor column: stepped round plinth with a hazard ring, a glowing core cylinder inside tapered cage ribs, coil rings and a domed top cap.
rows.name: Reactor

rows.description: Command seat: tapered hex swivel base, upholstered seat and tilted backrest with a headrest wing, armrests with small emissive panels. Faces -Y.
rows.name: Seat

rows.description: Pressure tank: lathed capsule with domed ends and two painted bands, a valve wheel, standing on a hex foot ring (upright) or two tapered saddles (horizontal).
rows.name: Tank

rows.description: Info terminal: a tapered pillar (stand) or a wall panel with a tilted emissive screen, a keypad ledge and a status light.
rows.name: Terminal

rows.description: Vent: chamfered frame, recessed grille plate and a three-blade fan hub behind it. wall stands on the floor against a wall (back on y = 0); floor lies in the deck.
rows.name: Vent

rows.description: Seeded heightfield terrain patch as a closed slab (top surface + skirt + bottom); rest height y=0 at the edges.
rows.name: Ground Patch

rows.description: Distant silhouette rings around the viewer (inward-facing, role 'vista' near / 'vista_far' beyond; v = 0 at the base .. 1 at the crest so packs paint haze gradients). Painted depth layers between the playfield and the sky.
rows.name: Far Hills

rows.description: Water (or ice) plane: thin closed slab with gentle seeded waves; material kind 'water' scrolls UVs in the runtime.
rows.name: Water

rows.description: Exterior yard (one-sided landscape shell): flat playfield (the room grid) ringed by readable terraces/ledges and an enclosing jagged ridge wall, passes cut where exits are, lighter path strips from exits to the centre, optional ice slabs/po
rows.name: Yard

rows.description: Altar on a two-step dais: dressed block with painted relief panels on the front and sides, overhanging top slab, a bronze offering bowl (optionally burning) and candle stubs.
rows.name: Altar

rows.description: Boss door: a towering stepped surround (jamb towers, sigil lintel, pediment, braziers' brackets) with sigil-painted arched leaves under a heavy iron lock. Shares the dgn.doorway door anchor and covers the standard frame; open = leaves and l
rows.name: Boss Door

rows.description: Temple column: square plinth, moulded base, fluted shaft with entasis, echinus capital and abacus slab; broken = snapped shaft with a jagged top and a fallen drum.
rows.name: Column

rows.description: Stepped temple dais on the grid (1 or 2 cells square): stacked dressed courses with a carved border on the top platform.
rows.name: Dais

rows.description: Temple floor tile (1-3 cells square): flagstones framed by a dressed border with a painted relief medallion inlaid at the centre.
rows.name: Floor

rows.description: Carved obelisk: tapered square shaft with chamfered edges, a pyramidion cap, softly glowing glyph panels on its four faces, on a stepped plinth.
rows.name: Obelisk

rows.description: Carved relief wall panel: painted relief slab (original motif) in a dressed frame with a lintel and a small sill, mounted on a wall face. Origin on the wall face at floor level; panel centred at 2.3 m.
rows.name: Relief

rows.description: Temple wall segment for one cell edge: the dungeon relief wall sheet with engaged columns at its ends, a painted frieze band under the cornice and a carved relief panel. Origin on the cell boundary at floor level.
rows.name: Wall

rows.description: Boat: rowboat/canoe/sailboat/skiff (thick U-section lofted hull with seats, oars, mast+sail, cabin) or log raft.
rows.name: Rowboat

rows.description: Ground craft: sled (runners), cart (2 wheels + handle), wagon (4 wheels), rover (rounded cab, 4 wheels), hover pod (skirt), saucer (lens hull, black window bands, light ring, optional glass dome, landing legs; wheel_radius/handle/cargo unus
rows.name: Runabout

rows.description: Bridge spanning two cells (8 m, along X): a humpbacked rubble arch bridge with cobbled deck and parapets, or a timber footbridge on trestles with hand rails. Path sockets at both ends.
rows.name: Bridge

rows.description: Beamed ceiling for vlg.room (one-sided, facing down so N64 cutaway cameras see in): dark boards on heavy oak joists across the short span (origin on the cell block centre at FLOOR level, like vlg.room).
rows.name: Ceiling

rows.description: Village chapel: rubble nave with dressed quoins and buttresses, steep slate roof, pointed-arch door, lancet windows of leaded glass, a rounded apse and a gable bell-cote with a bell under a simple cross.
rows.name: Chapel

rows.description: Village cottage in four original styles on a 2 m lattice lot: tapered walls, adzed oak framing as separate bevelled beams, a lofted roof with rolled eaves and a sagging ridge (thick bulging thatch, slate or clay pantiles), plank door with a
rows.name: Cottage

rows.description: THE medieval door (styles bind room.gd's arch.door to it): adzed oak frame with a lintel, a plank leaf with iron straps (painted leaf), a stone threshold; origin on the room.gd door anchor (0.4 m in from the room edge), front +Z toward the
rows.name: Doorway

rows.description: Fence on a cell edge (4 m along X): woven wattle hurdles between stakes, post-and-rail, a dry-stone wall with capstones, or a rail fence with a field gate. wall_end sockets at +-2 m.
rows.name: Fence

rows.description: Village gatehouse spanning a 3.2 m arched passage: rubble piers, deep voussoir arch, jettied timber room above with a roof; plank gate leaves closed or swung open (a state pair). wall_end sockets at +-3.5 m meet vlg.wall segments.
rows.name: Gatehouse

rows.description: Inglenook hearth for a hearth socket (wall-face anchor, front +Z): rubble cheeks, an oak bressumer under a plastered chimney breast rising to the ceiling, flagstone hearth slab, burning logs (fire glows, baked warm).
rows.name: Hearth

rows.description: Village mill: a tapered whitewashed tower mill with a stone footing, thatched cap and four lattice sails, or a rubble watermill with a paddle wheel on its gable.
rows.name: Mill

rows.description: Timber-framed interior shell on the room grid (3.4 m storey): whitewashed panels between oak studs on cell boundaries, a mid rail and a plank skirting, plank floor with a flagstone border, door cuts for vlg.doorway, painted windows, hearth
rows.name: Room

rows.description: Village smithy: rubble forge-house with a slate roof and an open-fronted lean-to workshop on timber posts, a stone forge with a glowing fire bed (baked warm pool), hood and tall chimney.
rows.name: Smithy

rows.description: Exterior steps up a terrace (rising toward +Y / north): rubble flight with dressed treads and side cheeks, or an open timber stair with stringers. Path sockets at the foot and the head.
rows.name: Stairs

rows.description: Market stall: plank counter on four posts under a sloping striped awning with a hanging valance, dressed with goods (produce crates, folded cloth, pots or loaves).
rows.name: Stall

rows.description: Two-storey village inn: rubble ground floor, jettied whitewashed upper storey with oak framing and braces, deep clay-tile (or thatch / slate) roof, external stone chimney, a projecting bracket with a BLANK sign board, a door lantern baked w
rows.name: Tavern

rows.description: Town wall segment on a cell edge (4 m along X, origin on the boundary): rubble wall with a coping and wall-walk merlons, a postern with a door socket, corner and end pieces, or a sharpened log palisade. wall_end sockets at +-2 m interlock s
rows.name: Wall

rows.description: Village well: round rubble well-head with a dressed coping, still water inside, two oak posts carrying a windlass with rope and bucket under a little pitched roof.
rows.name: Well

rows.description: Sand dune: a soft mound, a crescent dune with a steep slip face on its lee (north) side, or a long wind ridge; closed solid sunk 0.2 m below the ground datum so its foot meets any ground tile.
rows.name: Dune

rows.description: Fern: a rosette of arching two-sided fronds (fan) or a tall upright spray, rooted in a small leaf-litter mound.
rows.name: Fern

rows.description: Jungle deadwood: a fallen mossy log with a broken end, a tangle of arching surface roots, or a hollow stump.
rows.name: Log

rows.description: Oasis pool (the lane's own water piece): a water disc at WATER_Z = -0.25 m (water role, slow UV scroll, no wobble) inside a closed bank ring that slopes from the ground datum into the water, with a reed bed and lily pads, on a square ground
rows.name: Oasis

rows.description: Date palm: a gently curved trunk of chevron leaf-base scales tapering to a crown of V-folded two-sided fronds with a date cluster; leaning = strong lean (oasis edge); young = short with a low crown; twin = two trunks from one root. Origin a
rows.name: Palm

rows.description: Reeds and grasses: a tuft of blades, tall umbel-topped water reeds (papyrus-like heads, two-sided) or a low dry grass clump; two-sided blades. Origin at the root.
rows.name: Reeds

rows.description: Rocks: a weathered boulder, a cluster of three, a wind-carved pillar rock (stacked strata lumps with a cap) or a tilted slab outcrop.
rows.name: Rock

rows.description: Shrub: a desert scrub of low leaf masses on dry stems, a jungle broadleaf clump of big drooping two-sided leaves, or a flowering bush (foliage masses dotted with blossom clusters).
rows.name: Shrub

rows.description: Jungle tree: a straight trunk on four buttress roots under a crown of rounded leaf clumps (a high dome over three lower clumps) with a few hanging vines; tall = slimmer, higher crown; strangler = roots and trunk wrapped around a broken ston
rows.name: Tree

rows.description: Hanging vine curtain for a wall top (wall-mounted, origin on the wall face at floor level): leafy strands of uneven length draped from the top edge and a mossy leaf roll along the coping.
rows.name: Vines

rows.description: Natural rock arch: two lumpy layered legs joined by a sagging lofted span (a seeded lumpy section swept along an arch curve); walkable underneath, a postcard landmark.
rows.name: Arch

rows.description: Desert boulders: faceted rounded rocks (one big, smaller companions) bedded into the sand.
rows.name: Boulder

rows.description: Butte / chimney rock: a narrow tower of layered rock on a talus cone, a slightly overhanging cap rock and a flat top; the far-silhouette landmark of a canyon.
rows.name: Butte

rows.description: Canyon wall: a one-sided layered red-rock face on the lot line with stepped strata ledges, desert-varnish beds, a buttressed crest and a receding mesa-top cap; straight runs tile end to end, corner turns 90 degrees inward, end / end_w slope
rows.name: Canyon Wall

rows.description: Dead desert tree: a gnarled, leaning bleached trunk (swept tube) with crooked bare branches forking up.
rows.name: Dead Tree

rows.description: Dry bunch grass: a tuft of tapered straw blades (closed thin spines) splaying from a small base.
rows.name: Grass

rows.description: Desert ground patch: a one-sided terrain sheet of painted sand that settles to the floor datum at its edges; dunes add soft wind-blown swells, ruts paint a wagon road (path role) across the middle.
rows.name: Ground

rows.description: Hoodoos: eroded rock spires with pinched waists (lathe of an irregular profile) wearing hard flat cap stones; a cluster of one to four.
rows.name: Hoodoo

rows.description: Rock shelf: a raised layered rock step (closed loft) with a flat sandy top to climb onto; stacks into terraces.
rows.name: Ledge

rows.description: Free-standing mesa: a broad talus skirt, layered steep flanks with a hard cap-rock ledge and a flat scrubby top; a closed loft of seeded lumpy rings (beds share their jitter so the strata read as continuous layers).
rows.name: Mesa

rows.description: Oasis: a sunken pool of still water ringed by rocks and grass tufts, shaded by fan palms; the green surprise of a canyon floor.
rows.name: Oasis

rows.description: Desert fan palm: a ringed curving trunk, a shaggy skirt of dead fronds and a crown of fan fronds (two-sided cards).
rows.name: Palm

rows.description: Dry riverbed (wash): a one-sided terrain block with a sunken sandy channel between sloped cracked-earth banks that rise back to the floor datum toward the block edges, scattered river stones along the bed; a large block is a whole canyon fl
rows.name: Riverbed

rows.description: Sagebrush / desert scrub: a low mound of lumpy grey-green foliage blobs on twiggy stems, wider than tall.
rows.name: Scrub

rows.description: Talus ramp: a closed wedge of packed scree rising from the floor to a ledge top (walkable slope), lumpy flanks and a few loose stones at its foot.
rows.name: Slope

rows.description: Yucca: a rosette of stiff sword leaves (closed tapered spines) radiating from a short trunk, with an optional tall flower stalk.
rows.name: Yucca

rows.description: Ore cart: a tapered riveted tub on a timber frame with four small painted wheels and couplers; loaded with a heap of ore or empty, optionally tipped on its side as wreckage dressing.
rows.name: Cart

rows.description: Timber headframe over a mine shaft: four battered legs with girts and X-bracing, back braces, a sheave wheel (painted disc) on top, a hoist rope down to a cage and a timber shaft collar with a dark shaft card. Origin on the shaft centre (ba
rows.name: Headframe

rows.description: Wall ladder of split poles with lashed rungs, leaning slightly; wall-mounted dressing for shafts, lofts and galleries.
rows.name: Ladder

rows.description: Ore bin (tipple): a sloped-bottom plank bin on four timber stilts with cross bracing and a hinged chute over a track, a ramp-side catwalk rail on top.
rows.name: Ore Bin

rows.description: Spoil / ore heap: a low rounded mound of faceted rock lumps with a few loose stones around its foot.
rows.name: Ore Pile

rows.description: Mine entrance: a one-sided rock cliff face with a cut opening on a door socket (the runtime timber frame is wtown.doorway), dark tunnel depth behind it, horizontal lagging logs over the cap and a blank sign board above.
rows.name: Portal

rows.description: Cave-in rubble: a heap of broken rock with a snapped timber post and a fallen cap beam across it.
rows.name: Rubble

rows.description: Shaft collar: a square timber frame around a dark shaft opening in the floor, guard rails on three sides and a ladder top; reads as a way down.
rows.name: Shaft

rows.description: Standalone mine timber set: two battered posts, a cap beam with blocking wedges; spans a 3 m passage, a cave mouth or a shoring line.
rows.name: Timber Set

rows.description: Narrow-gauge mine track (0.6 m): straight cell, a 2 m radius cell corner (south to east) or a buffer end with a timber chock; light sleepers on a thin ballast bed.
rows.name: Track

rows.description: Mine tunnel cell (4 m): one-sided rough rock walls around a 3 m passage, a dirt floor and a low rock ceiling, timber sets (battered posts, cap, wedges) every 2 m. Kinds: straight, corner, tee, cross, end, end_door (the north arm runs out th
rows.name: Tunnel

rows.description: Hand windlass over a prospect hole: two A-frame uprights, a log drum with a crank handle, rope down to a wooden bucket, a plank collar around a dark hole.
rows.name: Windlass

rows.description: Saloon bar: a long panelled counter with a polished top, a brass foot rail and a raised lip; or the back bar - shelving of bottles (painted shelf texture) under a cornice with a mirror panel.
rows.name: Bar

rows.description: Barrel: a bulged stave barrel with iron hoops; keg (squat), water barrel (lid and dipper), powder keg (painted band) or tipped on its side.
rows.name: Barrel

rows.description: Table dressing: whiskey bottles (lathe, glass role) and short glasses in a little cluster.
rows.name: Bottles

rows.description: Small vessel: a stave bucket with a rope bail, a brass spittoon, or a tin wash basin.
rows.name: Bucket

rows.description: Desert cactus: a ribbed columnar saguaro with upturned arms, an organ-pipe clump of stems, a prickly pear of flat pads with red fruit, or a squat barrel cactus with a flower crown.
rows.name: Cactus

rows.description: Campfire: a ring of stones around crossed logs with emissive flame cards and a warm baked light.
rows.name: Campfire

rows.description: Seat: a spindle-back saloon chair, a bar stool, a rocking chair on curved runners, or a plank bench.
rows.name: Chair

rows.description: Crate: a chamfered box with board edges (crate), an open slatted crate, a long box (rifle / tool box) or a stencilled powder box with rope handles.
rows.name: Crate

rows.description: Hay: a bound rectangular bale (rounded, twine bands) or a small stack of three bales.
rows.name: Hay

rows.description: Lamp: a hanging barn lantern with a wire bail, a wall bracket lantern, a street lamp on a post, or a table oil lamp with a glass chimney; the glowing glass is emissive and night packs bake a warm pool around it.
rows.name: Lantern

rows.description: Upright saloon piano: a tall cabinet with a fallboard and keyboard shelf, turned front legs, a music rest and a round stool.
rows.name: Piano

rows.description: Grain / flour sacks: soft tied bags slumped against each other.
rows.name: Sacks

rows.description: Freestanding batwing saloon doors for an interior doorway: two scalloped half-height leaves on hinge posts with a lintel board.
rows.name: Saloon Doors

rows.description: Crossroads signpost: a tall post with blank pointed direction boards at different headings and heights.
rows.name: Signpost

rows.description: Bleached steer skull: a tapered muzzle and brow with dark eye sockets and long curved horns; desert dressing.
rows.name: Skull

rows.description: Pot-belly stove: a bulging cast-iron lathe body on three short legs with a glowing grate window and a stovepipe rising to the ceiling.
rows.name: Stove

rows.description: Table: a round saloon table on a turned pedestal, a square four-legged table, a card table with a felt top, or a long trestle table with benches' height.
rows.name: Table

rows.description: Grave marker: a round-topped headstone on a plinth, a timber cross, a painted wooden board marker, or a cairn of stones over a low mound.
rows.name: Tombstone

rows.description: Water trough: a long plank trough on splayed legs with iron end bands and still water inside.
rows.name: Trough

rows.description: Wagon: a covered prairie wagon (plank box, canvas hoops, spoked painted wheels, tongue), an open buckboard with a bench seat, or a broken wreck with a fallen wheel.
rows.name: Wagon

rows.description: Notice board: a plank board in a frame (on two posts with a little roof, or wall-mounted) pinned with blank wanted posters (empty heading and portrait frame, no text).
rows.name: Wanted Board

rows.description: Fieldstone well: a round stone curb (lathe with a coping lip) around dark water, two posts carrying a log windlass with crank and rope bucket, and a little shingle roof.
rows.name: Well

rows.description: Spare wagon wheel: a painted spoked wheel leaning against a wall (or lying flat).
rows.name: Wheel

rows.description: Water-pumping windmill: a tapering four-leg lattice tower with girts and cross braces, a multi-blade fan wheel, a tail vane, a pump rod down to a pump head over a round stock tank.
rows.name: Windmill

rows.description: Freight car on two four-wheel trucks: a board-and-batten boxcar with a curved roof and sliding door, a flatcar with stake pockets and a lashed load, or a caboose with a rooftop cupola and end platforms.
rows.name: Car

rows.description: Pump handcar: a plank deck on four small painted wheels with a timber frame, a central A-frame and a see-saw pump lever with cross handles at both ends.
rows.name: Handcar

rows.description: Small frontier steam locomotive: a tapered boiler with a flared smokestack, steam and sand domes, a square headlamp, a pilot, two big painted driving wheels and one small leading wheel a side, and a cab with a curved roof and side windows.
rows.name: Locomotive

rows.description: Station platform module (4 m): a raised plank deck with a timber edge beam on posts, end ramp on end pieces. Lot-line piece joining end to end on walk sockets, the track runs along its front.
rows.name: Platform

rows.description: Semaphore signal: a tapered timber mast with a ladder, a painted arm on a pivot, a lamp box with a lit lens and a finial cap.
rows.name: Signal

rows.description: Small frontier depot: a board-and-batten building under a low gable with deep overhanging eaves on knee braces over the platform, a projecting telegrapher's bay window, a ticket window, a plank door, a blank station-name board on the gable
rows.name: Station

rows.description: Standard-gauge track on a ballast berm: straight 4 m cell, 90 degree curve of 6 m radius over a 2 x 2 block, a timber buffer stop, or a road crossing (plank fill between and beside the rails). Joins on track sockets at cell-edge midpoints.
rows.name: Track

rows.description: Timber trestle bridge module (4 m): a bent of four battered posts with cap, sill and X-bracing under a deck of stringers, sleepers and rails with guard timbers; modules join on track sockets, 'end' adds a cribbed log abutment.
rows.name: Trestle

rows.description: Frontier sky dome: inward-facing hemisphere (kit_shell_sky, role sky, u = azimuth, v = elevation; the horizon sits at v = 0.0875, matching the wk_sky texture's distant mesas and horizon haze). The pack variant paints noon, golden hour, nigh
rows.name: Dome

rows.description: Distant mesa ring: an inward-facing band whose top edge follows seeded butte and mesa silhouettes (flat tops, steep shoulders), painted with the vista haze gradient; sits inside the sky dome between the playfield and the painted horizon so
rows.name: Mesas

rows.description: Sun / moon disc: a single emissive octagonal card (role light) to hang high in the backdrop, facing the viewer.
rows.name: Sun

rows.description: Upper balcony for a two-storey frontage: a plank deck on diagonal knee braces with a railing. Lot-line piece in front of the facade at the second-storey floor.
rows.name: Balcony

rows.description: Bank: a two-storey fieldstone block with a flat roof, a heavy bracketed cornice and stepped parapet, a string course, round-arched ground-floor windows and door, tall upper windows and a blank name plaque.
rows.name: Bank

rows.description: Raised plank boardwalk module along a lot line (4 m long, 2 m deep, 0.3 m high): painted planks over joist posts; end_w / end_e close one end with a plank step, steps adds a step down in front, ends closes both.
rows.name: Boardwalk

rows.description: Frontier chapel: white-washed lap siding under a steep shingle roof, a square front tower with louvred belfry, a tapering spire crowned by a simple cross, pointed-arch windows and double doors at the top of three plank steps.
rows.name: Church

rows.description: Timber doorway frame on the door anchor (bound as arch.door): two chamfered posts, a heavy header beam with corbels and a threshold board, 2.4 x 3.0 m clear. Reads as a door casing on a facade, a ranch gate in a fence line and the timber se
rows.name: Doorway

rows.description: False-front shop facade on a shallow gabled body: shaped parapet (square / stepped / arched / gabled / pediment / tall), cornice, blank sign board, door and window(s), optional porch roof or striped awning; the cheap filler that makes a mai
rows.name: Facade

rows.description: Fence segment along one cell edge (4 m): ranch rails, a cemetery picket fence, a gateway (two tall posts and rail stubs around a 2.4 m gap that carries a door socket for road exits) or a broken run with a fallen rail.
rows.name: Fence

rows.description: Interior gallery (mezzanine) along a wall: a plank floor on posts at the upper storey with a railing along the front; a gap in the railing at one end meets a wtown.stairs flight. Origin on the room's inner wall line.
rows.name: Gallery

rows.description: Hitching rail: rough hewn posts with a worn top rail and iron tie rings.
rows.name: Hitching Post

rows.description: Two-storey hotel: side-gabled shingle roof with two dormers, a two-level veranda across the front (posts, upper gallery with railing, shed roof), a long blank sign board between the floors and rows of windows.
rows.name: Hotel

rows.description: Porch roof / awning over a boardwalk: a sloped plank (or striped canvas, or tin) roof from the facade to two or three posts at the boardwalk edge. Lot-line piece in front of a building frontage.
rows.name: Porch

rows.description: Frontier interior shell on the 4 m grid: one-sided walls with a baseboard, plank wainscot under a chair rail, papered upper walls and a crown board, a plank floor, a plank ceiling with chamfered beams, door cuts on cell-edge midpoints for t
rows.name: Room

rows.description: Two-storey frontier saloon: lap-sided body under a shingle gable, a tall shaped false front with a bracketed cornice and a blank sign board, an upper balcony on posts with a railing, batwing doors between two windows, upper windows and a st
rows.name: Saloon

rows.description: Homesteader's shack: a small board-and-batten cabin with a corrugated tin (or shingle) gable roof, a crooked stovepipe, one window, a plank door and a little porch on two posts.
rows.name: Shack

rows.description: Sheriff's office and jail: a lap-sided office with a pediment false front, blank plaque and porch roof beside a fieldstone cell block with small barred windows.
rows.name: Sheriff

rows.description: Livery stable: a steep-gabled barn of painted board-and-batten facing the street, big double doors, a hayloft door under a hoist beam with a pulley and rope, a vent cupola on the ridge and an open lean-to on one side.
rows.name: Stable

rows.description: Exterior or interior plank stair to a balcony or gallery: a solid sawtooth stair block (stringer profile on the sides) with an open handrail on posts.
rows.name: Stairs

rows.description: General store: one storey with a tall false front, cornice and blank sign, two big display windows, a plank door and a shingled porch roof on posts over the boardwalk.
rows.name: Store

rows.description: Water tower: a stave tank with a conical shingle cap on four splayed timber legs with X-bracing and girts, an octagonal deck, a side ladder and (optional) a hinged spout chute for the railroad.
rows.name: Water Tower
